_meta.scope: Why microreactors tab: Type G checks on time-sensitive numbers in the arguments file; Type N items for studies or reports dated after 2026-11-13 that change the case for or against 1-20 MW reactors.
angles_run: Price-Anderson retrospective premium (10 CFR 140.11 inflation adjustment)
EPRI advanced reactor / microreactor studies November 2026
GAO / CBO reports on SMRs and microreactors 2026
Web lead: INL and Purdue construction demonstration (ANS, ~2026-11-09)
ERCOT Small Generation threshold and process durations
Insurer / lender reports on microreactors this week
National laboratory microreactor cost per kWh 2026
absences: No study, report or analysis dated 2026-11-14 to 2026-11-16 found on any angle searched, so zero Type N items. Searches covered DOE Liftoff, EPRI, GAO, CBO, NEI, insurer and lender reports, and national-lab cost work.
DOE Liftoff: the Liftoff report series exists on liftoff.energy.gov, but no microreactor-specific edition with a 2026 date was found.
EPRI: the Advanced Reactors Global Market and Technology Overview is dated November 2024, with a 2026 revision planned but not found. No November 2026 release found.
GAO / CBO: no 2026 GAO or CBO product on SMRs or microreactors found. The latest federal analysis found was EIA (April 2026), which is not a post-11-13 item.
NEI: no November 2026 NEI microreactor report found.

Web lead, ANS ~2026-11-09 (INL and Purdue construction demonstration): out of scope. It is an ACTI construction-methods demonstration for steel-plate composite containment at Purdue, announced by NRIC on 2026-11-05, with no microreactor. Not a record.

Liability: 10 CFR 140.12 formula floor ($4,500,000) and cap ($74,000,000) for reactors under 100,000 kWe could not be verified; the fetched Federal Register page (2023-19009) does not cover 140.12. The $500,000,000 primary protection figure was not checked.
Liability: no 2026 Price-Anderson inflation adjustment found. The next is due within five years of the 2023 rule, so the $158,026,000 figure may change before 2028.

Thresholds: ERCOT's 10 MW Small Generation threshold appears unchanged (ERCOT Planning Guide Section 5). PGRR 140 (ROS report 2026-08-06) proposes further revisions to the sub-10 MW interconnection process, status unconfirmed. The 8-12 month and 18-30 month process durations could not be verified: the ERCOT ROS report fetched as a .docx returned binary content with no readable text.
Quotes for the Federal Register check were taken from a WebFetch summary and should be re-verified against the raw bytes.

checks.claim: A 300 MWe unit carries $500,000,000 of primary financial protection and accepts a contingent retrospective assessment of $158,026,000.
checks.evidence: Federal Register final rule (Sept. 5, 2023; effective Oct. 5, 2023) on the fourth periodic inflation adjustment of Price-Anderson financial protection sets the maximum total deferred premium at $158,026,000 per reactor, with a maximum annual deferred premium of $24,714,000. The rule does not restate the $500,000,000 primary figure, which is not checked here. No 2026 adjustment was found.

sources.label: Federal Register — Inflation Adjustments to the Price-Anderson Act Financial Protection Regulations (2023-19009), 88 FR 60565
